slices.focus: Student loan payment jumps; Tasha enrolls in income-driven plan and rebuilds budget
slices.summary: Tasha receives notice that her federal student loan payment is about to jump, threatening her already tight $62k budget. Instead of panicking, she pulls out pay stubs and a yellow legal pad, maps rent/groceries/gas, and realizes absorbing the increase would leave her one car repair away from crisis. She enrolls in an income-driven repayment plan to keep monthly payments manageable. The agent helps her frame this as stability over pride, plan a holding budget until the confirmation arrives, and selectively tell one trusted person (Denise) rather than either hiding it or broadcasting it to the whole family.
